source_jd_text:
We are looking for a motivated fresher with a strong foundation in Python, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science. The candidate will work on data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, machine learning models, and AI/LLM-based applications.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured datasets.
Perform exploratory data analysis and identify meaningful patterns.
Develop and evaluate supervised and unsupervised machine learning models.
Apply classification and regression techniques to real-world problems.
Evaluate models using appropriate metrics such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and RMSE.
Work with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
Develop AI/Generative AI applications using LLMs and APIs.
Implement basic RAG pipelines using embeddings and vector databases.
Work with SQL databases and write queries for data analysis.
Build prototypes or dashboards using tools such as Streamlit.
Perform model testing, debugging, and performance improvement.
Document experiments, results, and technical implementations.

Required Skills

Python
SQL
Pandas and NumPy
Scikit-learn
Machine Learning fundamentals
Data preprocessing and EDA
Classification and regression
Model evaluation
Basic statistics
Git/GitHub

Good to Have

Generative AI / LLMs
RAG
Embeddings
Vector databases such as ChromaDB or FAISS
LangChain
Ollama
Streamlit
REST APIs
Docker
AI/ML evaluation tools

Education

B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.

Suitable Candidate
A fresher who has completed academic/personal projects involving Machine Learning, Data Science, AI, or Generative AI, and can explain the data, methodology, models, evaluation, and results of their projects.
candidate_positioning: Fresher positioning based only on current JD relevance and source-supported profile evidence.

projects_to_include.name: Student Performance RAG Chatbot
projects_to_include.purpose: Answer questions about student-performance records using a local retrieval-augmented generation system.
technical_details: Local LLM and embedding workflow; top-five retrieval by default; tests cover preprocessing, retrieval, vector storage and RAG
measurable_results: README documents 6,607 student records and 20 original columns; vector store indexes 6,607 student documents; retriever uses top five results by default.
lifecycle_notes: Repository presence does not establish project completion; lifecycle status requires candidate confirmation.
README and configuration/dependency evidence describe a RAG application, but do not explicitly establish completed versus in-progress status; manual confirmation required.

review_flags: Resume claim of approximately 18% minority-class recall improvement was not independently verified from repository evidence.
Resume claim of reducing 30+ features to 12 was not independently verified from repository evidence.
projects_to_include.name: SmartFraud Classifier
projects_to_include.purpose: Detect fraudulent credit-card transactions and compare classification algorithms.
technical_details: Binary fraud classification; notebooks include SMOTE and model comparison
measurable_results: README documents 284,807 transactions and 30 transaction-related features; notebook output shows 284,807 rows and 31 columns including target.
lifecycle_notes: Repository presence does not establish project completion; lifecycle status requires candidate confirmation.
README and notebooks show implemented model-analysis artifacts, but do not explicitly establish lifecycle status; manual confirmation required.

review_flags: External API model names in the repository were not independently verified.
projects_to_include.name: Text-to-SQL Project
projects_to_include.purpose: Convert natural-language questions into SQL queries and execute them against a SQLite sales database.
technical_details: Defines customers and orders tables; generated SQL is instructed to be SQLite-compatible
measurable_results: Sample database contains 5 customers and 10 orders; repository includes a total-sales-by-customer example.
lifecycle_notes: Repository presence does not establish project completion; lifecycle status requires candidate confirmation.
README and source files show an implemented demo and database workflow, but do not explicitly establish lifecycle status; manual confirmation required.
